git add src/orchestration/reportUsageAcrossRounds.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "test(orchestrator): acceptance tests for accumulating usage across tool rounds

Define acceptance tests for ticket #93: report usage across every tool round,
not just the last. Tests verify that multiple provider calls' usage is
accumulated (summed) rather than only the final round being reported to the
afterModelResponse hook.

Failing tests:
- accumulates usage from multiple tool rounds into a single total
- accumulates reported usage when some rounds report none

Passing tests:
- turn with no tool calls reports the same usage as before
- turn with no usage reported on any round passes undefined to hook
